originality.rationale: The exact-q-one finite-node filtered-variance law, sharp node threshold, stiff covariance asymptotics, and forced-ODE zero-uncertainty numerical-error example were compared with the full applicable primary sections of arXiv:2305.14978 and with arXiv:2306.07774.
